recipes.sourceCrs: Historical geographic latitude/longitude as published in the 1887 Anglo-Russian protocol; prime meridian/datum not independently registered in History Core
recipes.pointSemantics: published 1887 trigonometric/pillar controls: pillar 20, pillar 24, pillar 26, pillar 27, Kalari 2, pillar 30 and pillar 32
recipes.note: These controls are only a verified subset of the final 79-post frontier network. The protocol explicitly assigns mixed segment types between the controls, including watersheds, straight lines and thalwegs; therefore MultiPoint is mandatory and no line interpolation is permitted.
